verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks for GitHub Mobile. The cited items cover mobile push notifications, Copilot agent tasks, and the GitHub REST, GraphQL and Actions platform. Push notifications are not webhooks, and the Copilot event-triggered automations are an adjacent agent feature, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
